title: Semialgebraic universal covers and bounded domains

result.label: Semialgebraic universal covers and bounded domains
result.statement: Proves the Kollár–Pardon conjecture: the semialgebraic universal covers of connected normal projective complex varieties are exactly products D C^m F, with D bounded symmetric and F simply connected, normal, and projective. A universal cover is quasi-projective exactly when the bounded symmetric factor is absent. In particular, a smooth projective variety covered by ℂ n has a finite étale cover by an abelian variety.
